<STBG 12,0><BGM 0,0,505><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,1,1,0,0><CHAR 5,1,9,0,0><CV 1,20>No way...
It's always in the sky, I can't reach it!

<TALK 5><NAME 11>I've anticipated it.
I have a countermeasure.

<TALK 5><NAME 11>A tube made from the materials you gathered.
With this, we fire a special barrel bomb.

<CV 10,37>If this hits,
we can drag that thing down to the earth.

<CV 10,19>Let's go, you lot!
The ringleader is right there!
